stem: What happens next in this passage after “A woman brought a yellowing tomato plant.”?
options: A boy once brought a toy train that had not moved for two years.
No one knew who brought it to the classroom.
A little boy began counting pigeons on the platform.
A boy brought a cactus that had become soft.

本文可直接核對「A woman brought a yellowing tomato plant. A boy brought a cactus that had become soft.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
